title: Protected actions require authentication
rule: All purchase and account mutations require authenticated identity
rationale: 购买和账户变更涉及真实金钱和隐私，未认证调用会造成越权操作和资金风险
scope: 所有 purchase/account 写操作接口

title: Billing contract changes require approval
rule: Price, renewal, refund, and entitlement semantics require business approval
rationale: 价格、续费、退款和权益语义直接关系收入，AI 不能自行判断业务取舍，需人工确认
scope: billing 模块的价格/续费/退款/权益字段

title: No silent data loss on upgrade
rule: CLI upgrades must not silently rewrite project data in harness/project/ or specs/
rationale: CLI 升级时静默重写项目数据会丢失人工积累的踩坑和决策记录，破坏信任
scope: harness/project/ 和 specs/ 下的所有文件

title: API rate limits cannot be weakened
rule: API rate limits must not be removed or weakened without load testing
rationale: 限流是稳定性最后防线，AI 无权判断是否可放宽，必须人工压测后确认
scope: 所有对外 HTTP 端点的限流配置
examples: 把 rateLimit 从 100/min 改成 0
